title: cursor/plugins: the official specification and catalog for Cursor extensions
friendlyTitle: cursor/plugins adds ready-made abilities to Cursor agents
summary: Cursor’s repository defines its plugin format and collects official plugins that add skills, commands, agents, hooks and MCP integrations. Recent work includes broader agent compatibility and connectors for services such as Outlook, Outlook Calendar and OneDrive.
friendlySummary: This official repository contains plugins and rules for extending Cursor with new tools, commands and service connections.
whyItMatters: Cursor users can inspect or install reusable capabilities, while plugin authors can follow the schemas and examples to package consistent agent workflows. Review permissions and third-party integrations before enabling a plugin in sensitive repositories.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You can reuse a plugin instead of building every workflow yourself. Check what data and permissions it needs before installing it.
